overall: AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: although a quorum of the Committee attended the September 9 meeting, they did not deliberate, so no meeting requiring posted notice occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the School Committee failed to post notice of a September 9 gathering at which a quorum of members attended a girls' soccer fundraiser discussion.
allegations.key_passage: We find, here, that a quorum of the Committee did not deliberate during the September 9 meeting because the communications by those Committee members who did speak did not relate to Committee business.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
